description: Defines custom metrics API types for Kubernetes, including MetricIdentifier, MetricValue, MetricValueList, MetricListOptions, and ObjectReference, with associated metadata and licensing information.

classes.name: MetricIdentifier
classes.description: Represents a specific metric with optional label selector.

classes.name: MetricValueList
classes.description: Holds a list of MetricValue objects for a set of objects.

classes.name: MetricValue
classes.description: Represents a metric value for a specific object, including timestamp and window.

classes.name: MetricListOptions
classes.description: Options to filter metrics by label selectors.

classes.name: ObjectReference
classes.description: Contains information to identify or inspect a Kubernetes object.
